The student wants to emphasize how long the repair took.

options.en: Bobur Tursunov spent every weekend from March to October repairing the family's carved gate by hand.
The Tursunov family's old wooden gate, whose paint had cracked and whose hinges had rusted, is carved with leaves and birds.
Before the repair, the gate's paint had cracked and its hinges had rusted.
Bobur Tursunov repaired his family's old carved wooden gate by hand.

why.en: The goal is how long the work took. Only the choice with "every weekend from March to October" says anything about time.
why.uz: Maqsad — ish qancha davom etganini taʼkidlash. Vaqt haqida faqat «every weekend from March to October» boʻlgan javob aytadi.
why.ru: Цель — подчеркнуть, сколько длилась работа. О времени говорит только вариант с «every weekend from March to October».

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• In September, the school canteen began offering a free glass of milk at breakfast.
• Last year, about 60 students ate breakfast at school each day.
• This year, about 110 students do.
• The milk comes from a farm near the school.

The student wants to present the change in the number of students eating breakfast at school.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: About 60 students a day ate breakfast at school last year; this year, about 110 do.
Since September, the school canteen has offered a free glass of milk, which comes from a farm near the school, at breakfast.
The milk served at breakfast in the canteen comes from a farm near the school.
This year, about 110 students eat breakfast in the school canteen each day.

why.en: A change needs the before and the after. Only the choice with about 60 last year and about 110 this year shows it; another gives only this year.
why.uz: Oʻzgarish uchun oldingi va keyingi holat kerak. Uni faqat oʻtgan yili 60 ga yaqin, bu yil 110 ga yaqin boʻlgan javob koʻrsatadi; boshqasi faqat bu yilni beradi.
why.ru: Для изменения нужны «до» и «после». Его показывает только вариант с 60 в прошлом году и 110 в этом; другой даёт лишь этот год.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• On summer evenings, the town shows films on a big screen in the park.
• The films start when it gets dark, at about 9 p.m.
• Visitors bring their own blankets to sit on.
• There are no tickets, and nobody pays to enter.

The student wants to emphasize that the open-air cinema in the park is free.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: At the open-air cinema in the park, there are no tickets, and nobody pays to enter.
On summer evenings, the town shows films on a big screen in the park.
The films in the park start at about 9 p.m., when it gets dark.
Visitors to the open-air cinema in the park bring their own blankets to sit on when the films start at about 9 p.m.

why.en: The goal is that the cinema is free. Only the choice saying there are no tickets and nobody pays makes that point.
why.uz: Maqsad — ochiq havodagi kinoteatr bepul ekanini taʼkidlash. Buni faqat chipta yoʻqligi va hech kim pul toʻlamasligini aytgan javob qiladi.
why.ru: Цель — подчеркнуть, что кино бесплатное. Это делает только вариант о том, что билетов нет и никто не платит.

instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A small stone footbridge crosses the stream at the edge of the village.
• Local people call it the Swallow Bridge.
• It is named after the swallows that build their nests under its arch every spring.
• It was built about a hundred years ago.

The student wants to explain how the bridge got its name.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The footbridge is called the Swallow Bridge after the swallows that nest under its arch every spring.
A small stone footbridge, built about a hundred years ago, crosses the stream at the edge of the village.
Local people call the small stone footbridge at the edge of the village the Swallow Bridge.
Every spring, swallows come back to the stream at the edge of the village.

why.en: The goal is where the name comes from. Only the choice linking the name to the swallows nesting under the arch explains it; another only gives the name.
why.uz: Maqsad — nom qayerdan kelganini tushuntirish. Buni faqat nomni ravoq ostida uya quradigan qaldirgʻochlar bilan bogʻlagan javob qiladi; boshqasi faqat nomni aytadi.
why.ru: Цель — объяснить, откуда название. Это делает только вариант, связывающий название с ласточками, которые вьют гнёзда под аркой; другой лишь сообщает название.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The town sports school has a free climbing wall.
• Anyone aged 10 to 17 can use it.
• Climbers under 14 must come with an adult.
• The wall is open on Saturdays and Sundays.

The student wants to tell readers who may use the climbing wall.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Anyone aged 10 to 17 may use the free climbing wall, though climbers under 14 must come with an adult.
The climbing wall at the town sports school is free to use and is open every weekend, on Saturdays and Sundays.
The town sports school has a climbing wall that anyone may use for free on weekends.
Climbers under 14 must bring an adult with them to the climbing wall.

why.en: Who may use the wall needs the ages and the rule for the youngest. Only the choice with 10 to 17 and the adult rule gives both.
why.uz: Kim foydalana olishi uchun yosh chegarasi va kichiklar uchun qoida kerak. Ikkalasini faqat 10–17 yosh va 14 yoshdan kichiklar katta kishi bilan kelishi haqidagi qoida bor javob beradi.
why.ru: Чтобы сказать, кто может пользоваться скалодромом, нужны возраст и правило для младших. Оба даёт только вариант с 10–17 годами и правилом о взрослых.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The school garden club planted two kinds of melon seeds in May.
• The club expected the large striped melons to grow best.
• By August, the striped melon plants had given 6 melons.
• The small yellow melon plants had given 19.
• The yellow seeds were a gift from a club member's grandmother.

The student wants to show that the harvest did not match what the club expected.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The club expected its striped melons to do best, yet the small yellow ones gave 19 melons to their 6.
By August, the small yellow melon plants had given the school garden club 19 melons.
The yellow melon seeds that the club planted in May were a gift from a member's grandmother.
In May, the school garden club planted seeds of two kinds of melon: large striped ones and small yellow ones.

why.en: The goal sets the expectation against the harvest. Only the choice with the club's guess and 19 against 6 does both; another gives the harvest alone.
why.uz: Maqsad kutilgan natijani haqiqiy hosil bilan solishtirish. Ikkalasini faqat klubning taxmini va 6 ga qarshi 19 boʻlgan javob beradi; boshqasi faqat hosilni aytadi.
why.ru: Цель — противопоставить ожидание и урожай. Оба даёт только вариант с догадкой клуба и 19 против 6; другой называет лишь урожай.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Rustam and his cousin Zarina both learned to cook this year.
• Rustam learned from videos on his phone.
• Zarina learned from her aunt, who runs a small café.
• Both wanted to make dinner for their parents, who work late.

The student wants to stress what Rustam and Zarina have in common.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Rustam and Zarina both learned to cook this year so that they could make dinner for their parents, who work late.
Rustam learned to cook by watching videos on his phone, while his cousin Zarina learned from her aunt, who runs a small café.
Zarina learned to cook this year from her aunt, who runs a small café in the town.
This year, Rustam taught himself to cook by watching videos on his phone.

why.en: What they share is the year and the reason they learned: dinner for parents who work late. Only that choice holds both cousins; another stresses how they differ.
why.uz: Umumiy jihat — oʻrgangan yil va sabab: kech ishlaydigan ota-onaga kechki ovqat. Ikkala qarindoshni faqat shu javob qamraydi; boshqasi farqni taʼkidlaydi.
why.ru: Общее у них — год и причина: ужин для родителей, которые работают допоздна. Обоих охватывает только этот вариант; другой подчёркивает различие.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• On an average July day last year, 300 people swam in the town's outdoor pool.
• This July, about 120 did.
• A new indoor pool opened across the road in June.
• Many regular swimmers said they now prefer the indoor pool.
• Both pools charge the same price.

The student wants to explain why fewer people swam in the outdoor pool this July.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: About 120 people a day swam outdoors this July, down from 300, because many regulars now prefer the new indoor pool.
On an average July day last year, 300 people swam in the town's outdoor pool, which charges the same price as the new indoor one.
A new indoor pool, which charges the same price as the outdoor one, opened across the road in June.
This July, the town's outdoor pool had about 120 swimmers on an average day.

why.en: Explaining the fall needs the fall and its reason. Only the choice joining 300 and about 120 with the swimmers' new choice of pool gives both.
why.uz: Kamayishni tushuntirish uchun kamayishning oʻzi va sababi kerak. Ikkalasini faqat 300 dan 120 ga tushishni yangi hovuz bilan bogʻlagan javob beradi.
why.ru: Чтобы объяснить спад, нужны спад и его причина. Оба даёт только вариант, связывающий 300 и около 120 с выбором нового бассейна.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Behruz has collected stamps since he was eight.
• His collection holds 600 stamps.
• Every stamp in it shows a bird.
• He keeps them in albums sorted by color.

The student wants to give the size of Behruz's collection and say what all of its stamps have in common.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Behruz's collection holds 600 stamps, and every one of them shows a bird.
Behruz, who began collecting stamps at the age of eight, keeps them in albums.
Behruz keeps the 600 stamps of his collection in albums sorted by color.
Every one of the stamps that Behruz has collected since he was eight shows a bird.

why.en: The goal has two parts: the size and what the stamps share. Only the choice with 600 stamps that all show birds does both; others give one part.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: hajm va markalarning umumiy jihati. Ikkalasini faqat hammasida qush tasvirlangan 600 ta marka boʻlgan javob beradi.
why.ru: Цель из двух частей: размер и что общего у марок. Обе даёт только вариант с 600 марками, на всех птицы; другие дают одну часть.

instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Students in Class 10A wanted to cut the noise in their classroom.
• They glued felt pads under the legs of all 30 chairs.
• Before the pads, the teacher's sound meter showed 70 decibels during group work.
• After the pads, it showed 58 decibels.

The student wants to present both the aim of the project and its outcome.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: To make their classroom quieter, Class 10A put felt pads under its chairs; the noise fell from 70 to 58 decibels.
Class 10A glued felt pads under the legs of all 30 chairs in its classroom.
During group work, the noise in Class 10A's room fell from 70 to 58 decibels.
The students in Class 10A wanted to cut the noise in their classroom, so they glued felt pads under all 30 chairs.

why.en: The goal has two parts: the aim and the outcome. Only the choice with "to make their classroom quieter" and the fall from 70 to 58 decibels gives both.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: niyat va natija. Ikkalasini faqat «to make their classroom quieter» va 70 dan 58 detsibelga tushish bor javob beradi.
why.ru: Цель из двух частей: замысел и итог. Оба даёт только вариант с «to make their classroom quieter» и падением с 70 до 58 децибел.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Two routes lead from the town to the mountain lake.
• The road is 45 kilometers long and takes about one hour by car.
• The footpath over the pass is only 12 kilometers long.
• It takes about five hours on foot.
• The footpath is steep and rocky in places.

The student wants to recommend a route to a family traveling with small children.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: With small children, take the road: the footpath over the pass is steep and rocky in places and takes about five hours.
The footpath over the pass is only 12 kilometers long, far shorter than the 45-kilometer road, which takes about one hour by car.
The road from the town to the mountain lake takes about one hour by car.
Both a road and a footpath over the pass lead from the town to the mountain lake.

why.en: A recommendation needs a choice and a reason that fits the reader. Only the choice naming the road and the steep five-hour path does that for small children.
why.uz: Tavsiya uchun tanlov va shu oilaga mos sabab kerak. Kichik bolali oila uchun buni faqat yoʻlni tanlab, tik va besh soatlik soʻqmoqni aytgan javob qiladi.
why.ru: Для совета нужны выбор и причина, подходящая адресату. Для семьи с малышами это делает только вариант с дорогой и крутой пятичасовой тропой.

instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
In the old part of town, the bakers leave yesterday's unsold bread on a shelf outside their doors, where anyone who needs a loaf may take one. ______ the tailor on the same street keeps a box of spare buttons by her door for anyone who has lost one.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The tailor does the same kind of thing as the bakers: she leaves something free by her door. The second case matches the first, so "Likewise,".
why.uz: Tikuvchi ham novvoylar kabi ish qiladi: eshigi oldiga bepul narsa qoʻyadi. Ikkinchi holat birinchisiga oʻxshaydi, shuning uchun «Likewise,».
why.ru: Портниха поступает так же, как пекари: оставляет у двери что-то бесплатное. Второй случай повторяет первый, поэтому «Likewise,».

instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Nobody in the family expected Grandfather to enjoy the tablet that his grandchildren gave him. He soon used it every day. ______ within a month he was teaching his neighbors how to make video calls to their own grandchildren.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: Teaching the neighbors goes further than using the tablet every day: a stronger point of the same kind, so "In fact,". Nothing is contrasted.
why.uz: Qoʻshnilarni oʻrgatish planshetdan har kuni foydalanishdan ham oshib ketadi: shu turdagi kuchliroq fikr, shuning uchun «In fact,». Hech narsa zid emas.
why.ru: Учить соседей — больше, чем пользоваться планшетом каждый день: более сильная мысль того же рода, поэтому «In fact,». Ничто не противопоставлено.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
The new timetable at the sports school was planned around the students' lessons at their regular schools. ______ every training session now begins at four or later, after the last lesson of the day has ended in every school in town.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The second sentence gives the exact detail of how the timetable fits the lessons: sessions start at four or later. A general claim, then its detail: "Specifically,".
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap jadval darslarga qanday moslanganini aniq koʻrsatadi: mashgʻulotlar soat toʻrtda yoki undan kech boshlanadi. Umumiy fikr, keyin tafsilot: «Specifically,».
why.ru: Второе предложение называет точную деталь: занятия начинаются в четыре или позже. Общее утверждение, затем подробность: «Specifically,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
The village's new playground is far from perfect: it has no shade at all, and its metal slide gets too hot to touch in the afternoon sun. ______ on warm evenings it is the busiest place in the village, with children waiting in line for the swings.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The first sentence lists faults, yet the playground is the busiest place in the village. The second holds despite the first, so "Even so,".
why.uz: Birinchi gap kamchiliklarni sanaydi, lekin maydoncha qishloqdagi eng gavjum joy. Ikkinchi fikr birinchisiga qaramay toʻgʻri, shuning uchun «Even so,».
why.ru: Первое предложение перечисляет недостатки, но площадка — самое людное место деревни. Второе верно вопреки первому, поэтому «Even so,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Since last spring, the town library has lent sewing machines for a week at a time, and the machines are almost never on the shelf. ______ the only machines in town belonged to two tailors, who charged a fee for every hour of use.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The second sentence describes how things were before the library began lending machines last spring, so the link moves back in time: "Previously,".
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap kutubxona oʻtgan bahordan tikuv mashinalarini bera boshlashidan oldingi holatni tasvirlaydi, shuning uchun bogʻlanish oʻtmishga qaytadi: «Previously,».
why.ru: Второе предложение описывает, как было до того, как библиотека стала выдавать швейные машинки прошлой весной, поэтому связь уводит назад: «Previously,».

instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Zafar tried three ways to keep the pigeons off his balcony: a plastic owl, strips of shiny foil, and a radio left playing all day. The pigeons got used to each of them within a week. ______ he gave up and put out a small dish of water for the birds, and now his younger sisters feed them every morning.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: After three failed tries comes his final choice, to welcome the pigeons. "In the end," marks the outcome that closes the story.
why.uz: Uch marta muvaffaqiyatsiz urinishdan soʻng uning yakuniy qarori keladi — kaptarlarni qabul qilish. «In the end,» voqeani yakunlagan natijani bildiradi.
why.ru: После трёх неудачных попыток приходит его окончательный выбор — принять голубей. «In the end,» отмечает итог, которым история закончилась.

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
The baker on the corner says that her bread needs a "long rest" before it goes into the oven. ______ the dough must sit under a cloth for at least three hours while the yeast slowly makes it rise.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The second sentence says what "a long rest" means in plain words: the dough sits for three hours. A restatement takes "In other words,".
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap «a long rest» nimani anglatishini oddiy soʻzlar bilan aytadi: xamir uch soat turadi. Qayta aytishga «In other words,» mos.
why.ru: Второе предложение простыми словами объясняет «a long rest»: тесто стоит три часа. Для пересказа подходит «In other words,».

stem.en:
For years, the ice rink in the park was crowded only on weekends. Last winter the town put up bright lights around it and kept it open until ten at night. ______ the rink is now full on weekday evenings too, when students come after finishing their homework.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The blank links the lights and late hours to the full weekday evenings: cause and effect, "As a result,". "However" would answer the first sentence.
why.uz: Boʻsh joy chiroqlar va kech yopilishni ish kunlari kechqurun muz maydoni gavjum boʻlishi bilan bogʻlaydi: sabab va natija, «As a result,». «However» birinchi gapga javob boʻlardi.
why.ru: Пропуск связывает огни и долгие часы работы с тем, что по будням вечером каток полон: причина и следствие, «As a result,». «However» относилось бы к первому предложению.

stem.en:
The photography club's exhibition opened on a cold, rainy Monday, and the hall it was given had no heating. ______ more than two hundred visitors came in the first week, many of them returning with friends.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: Cold rain and an unheated hall would keep visitors away, yet over two hundred came. The outcome goes against the facts before it: "Nonetheless,".
why.uz: Sovuq yomgʻir va isitilmagan zal tashrifchilarni qaytarishi kerak edi, lekin ikki yuzdan ortiq kishi keldi. Natija oldingi faktlarga zid: «Nonetheless,».
why.ru: Холодный дождь и неотапливаемый зал должны были отпугнуть, но пришло больше двухсот человек. Итог идёт вопреки фактам: «Nonetheless,».

Many visitors assume that the old windmill on the hill once ground wheat into flour. It never did. ______ for most of its working life it pumped water from a deep well up to the orchards on the slope below.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: Pumping water is what the windmill did in place of grinding wheat, the job people wrongly assume. A replacement takes "Instead,".
why.uz: Suv chiqarish — shamol tegirmoni bugʻdoy tortish oʻrniga qilgan ish; odamlar esa u bugʻdoy tortgan deb notoʻgʻri oʻylaydi. Almashtirishga «Instead,» mos.
why.ru: Качать воду — то, что мельница делала вместо помола зерна, который ей ошибочно приписывают. Для замены нужно «Instead,».

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A "fix-it evening" is an event where volunteers repair broken things for free.
• Visitors bring lamps, toys, clothes or small machines.
• The town's first fix-it evening is held in the library on the last Sunday of each month.
• Last month, volunteers fixed 34 items.

The student wants to introduce fix-it evenings to readers who have never heard of one and say where the town's is held.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: At a fix-it evening, volunteers repair broken things for free; the town's is held in the library on the last Sunday of each month.
The town's first fix-it evening is held in the library on the last Sunday of each month.
Last month, the volunteers at the town's fix-it evening repaired a total of 34 broken items.
Visitors to a fix-it evening bring along broken lamps, toys, clothes or small machines.

why.en: The goal has two parts: what a fix-it evening is and where the town's is held. Only the choice that defines it and names the library does both.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: «fix-it evening» nima va shaharniki qayerda oʻtadi. Ikkalasini faqat uni taʼriflab, kutubxonani nomlagan javob qiladi.
why.ru: Цель из двух частей: что такое «fix-it evening» и где проходит городской. Оба делает только вариант с определением и библиотекой.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Oysha and Hamida are two neighbors who dry apricots every summer.
• Oysha dries hers on the flat roof of her house.
• Hamida dries hers on wooden racks in her yard.
• Both use apricots from their own trees.
• Both sell their dried apricots at the Saturday market.

The student wants to emphasize what the two women have in common while noting one difference.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Although Oysha uses her roof and Hamida uses racks in her yard, both dry apricots from their own trees and sell them at the Saturday market.
Oysha dries her apricots on the flat roof of her house, while Hamida dries hers on wooden racks in her yard.
Both women dry apricots from their own trees every summer and sell them at the Saturday market.
Every summer, Hamida dries apricots from her own trees on wooden racks in her yard.

why.en: The goal has two parts: what they share and one difference. Only the choice setting roof against racks, then giving the shared trees and market, does both.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: umumiy jihat va bitta farq. Ikkalasini faqat tom bilan tokchalarni solishtirib, soʻng umumiy daraxt va bozorni aytgan javob beradi.
why.ru: Цель из двух частей: общее и одно различие. Оба даёт только вариант, где крыша против сушилок, а затем общие деревья и рынок.

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The town's new bus stops have a request button.
• Pressing it lights a lamp on the roof of the shelter.
• The lamp tells the driver to stop.
• Before, drivers often passed stops where passengers were waiting in the dark.

The student wants to explain to readers who have never seen the button what it is for and how it works.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Pressing the request button at the new bus stops lights a lamp on the shelter's roof, which tells the driver to stop.
The town's new bus stops have a request button that passengers can press.
Before the new stops and their request buttons were put up, drivers often passed passengers who were waiting in the dark.
A lamp on the roof of each of the town's new bus shelters tells the driver to stop.

why.en: Readers who have never seen the button need what it does and why. Only the choice from pressing it to the lamp that tells the driver to stop explains both.
why.uz: Tugmani koʻrmaganlarga u nima qilishi va nima uchunligi kerak. Ikkalasini faqat bosishdan haydovchiga toʻxtashni bildiruvchi chiroqqacha aytgan javob tushuntiradi.
why.ru: Тем, кто не видел кнопку, нужно знать, что она делает и зачем. И то и другое объясняет только вариант, где описан весь путь: от нажатия до лампы, по которой водитель останавливается.

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Every spring, volunteers in the town plant trees along the canal.
• This spring, 85 volunteers took part.
• They planted 1,200 young poplar and willow trees.
• The work took two Saturdays.

The student wants to emphasize how large this spring's planting was.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: This spring, 85 volunteers planted 1,200 young trees along the canal in just two Saturdays.
Every spring, volunteers from the town plant young trees along the banks of the canal.
The young trees planted along the canal this spring were poplars and willows.
The volunteers who plant young trees along the canal each spring do the work on Saturdays.

why.en: Size is shown by numbers: 85 volunteers and 1,200 trees in two Saturdays. The other choices give the custom, the kinds of tree or the day.
why.uz: Hajm sonlar bilan koʻrsatiladi: ikki shanbada 85 koʻngilli va 1200 ta daraxt. Boshqa javoblar odat, daraxt turi yoki kunni aytadi.
why.ru: Размах показывают числа: 85 добровольцев и 1200 деревьев за две субботы. Остальные варианты дают обычай, породы деревьев или день.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A school tried a new kind of chalk that is said to make less dust.
• For one month, Room 12 used the new chalk.
• Room 14 kept the old chalk.
• At the end of the month, the shelves in Room 12 had much less dust.
• Room 12's windows were open all month, but Room 14's were closed for repairs.

The student wants to present the result while noting a reason to doubt that the chalk caused it.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Room 12, which used the new chalk, had much less dust, but its windows were open all month while Room 14's were closed.
After a month of using the new chalk, Room 12 had much less dust on its shelves than Room 14.
Room 12's windows were open for the whole month, while Room 14's windows were closed for repairs.
The new chalk made much less dust than the old chalk, as the month-long test in Room 12 showed.

why.en: The goal has two parts: the result and a doubt. Only the choice joining less dust with the open windows gives both; another states the chalk worked as fact.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: natija va shubha. Ikkalasini faqat kam changni ochiq derazalar bilan bogʻlagan javob beradi; boshqasi boʻrning foydasini fakt deb aytadi.
why.ru: Цель из двух частей: результат и сомнение. Оба даёт только вариант, где меньше пыли и открытые окна; другой выдаёт пользу мела за факт.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A plane tree stands in the courtyard of the old school.
• The school's records show that it was planted in 1890.
• Its trunk is so wide that four children holding hands can just reach around it.
• It is the tallest tree in the neighborhood.
• Birds nest in its upper branches every spring.

The student wants to emphasize both the tree's age and the width of its trunk.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Planted in 1890, the old school's plane tree has a trunk so wide that four children holding hands can just reach around it.
The school's records show that the plane tree in its courtyard was planted in 1890.
The plane tree in the courtyard of the old school, in whose upper branches birds nest every spring, is the tallest tree in the neighborhood.
Every spring, birds build their nests in the upper branches of the old school's plane tree.

why.en: The goal has two parts, age and width. Only the choice with 1890 and the four children around the trunk gives both; the others give one part or neither.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: yosh va tananing kengligi. Ikkalasini faqat 1890-yil va tanani quchoqlagan toʻrt bola boʻlgan javob beradi; qolganlari bittasini beradi yoki hech birini.
why.ru: Цель из двух частей: возраст и ширина ствола. Оба даёт только вариант с 1890 годом и четырьмя детьми вокруг ствола; другие — одну часть или ни одной.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The school's science fair is held every April in the gym.
• Students show their projects at tables.
• The fair is open to everyone in the town, not just students and parents.
• Entry is free.

The student wants to invite townspeople who think the fair is only for students and their parents.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Everyone in town is welcome at the school's free science fair in the gym this April, not just students and parents.
Every April, students show their projects at tables set up in the school gym.
Students and their parents come to the science fair in the school gym every April.
The school's science fair is held in the gym every April, and its entry is free.

why.en: These readers think the fair is not for them, so the sentence must say it is open to everyone. Only the choice with "not just students and parents" does that.
why.uz: Bu shaharliklar koʻrgazma ular uchun emas deb oʻylaydi, demak gap hamma uchun ochiq ekanini aytishi kerak. Buni faqat «not just students and parents» bor javob qiladi.
why.ru: Эти читатели думают, что ярмарка не для них, значит, нужно сказать, что она открыта всем. Это делает только вариант с «not just students and parents».

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The school's front steps froze every winter morning.
• Several students slipped on them last January.
• This winter, the caretaker laid rubber mats with deep grooves on the steps.
• The mats keep their grip even when wet.

The student wants to present both the problem with the steps and the caretaker's solution.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Because the school's front steps froze and students slipped on them, the caretaker laid grooved rubber mats on them this winter.
Several students slipped on the school's frozen front steps last January.
This winter, the caretaker laid rubber mats with deep grooves on the school's front steps, and the mats keep their grip even when wet.
This winter, the school's caretaker laid rubber mats on the front steps.

why.en: The goal has two parts: the problem and the fix. Only the choice with the frozen steps and slipping students, then the grooved mats, gives both.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: muammo va yechim. Ikkalasini faqat muzlagan zinalar va yiqilgan oʻquvchilar, soʻng chuqur oʻyiqli rezina gilamchalar bor javob beradi.
why.ru: Цель из двух частей: проблема и решение. Оба даёт только вариант с обледеневшими ступенями и падениями, а затем рифлёными ковриками.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Two sisters, Lobar and Madina, sell homemade jam at the market.
• On Saturday, Lobar sold 18 jars.
• Madina sold 6 jars.
• Lobar's jars are smaller and cheaper.

The student wants to compare how many jars the sisters sold on Saturday.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: On Saturday, Lobar sold 18 jars of jam, three times as many as Madina's 6.
On Saturday, Lobar sold 18 jars of jam, twice as many as Madina did.
Lobar's jars of homemade jam are smaller and cheaper than Madina's.
Madina sold 6 jars of her homemade jam at the market on Saturday.

why.en: Both numbers and their true relation are needed: 18 is three times 6. One choice says "twice", which the notes do not support; the others give one side.
why.uz: Ikkala son va ularning toʻgʻri nisbati kerak: 18 — 6 ning uch barobari. Bir javob «twice» deydi, qaydlar buni tasdiqlamaydi; qolganlari bir tomonni beradi.
why.ru: Нужны оба числа и верное соотношение: 18 — втрое больше 6. Один вариант говорит «twice», чего в заметках нет; другие дают одну сторону.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Shadow tag is a game for sunny days.
• The player who is "it" tries to step on another player's shadow.
• A player whose shadow is stepped on becomes "it".
• The game is best played in the late afternoon, when shadows are long.

The student wants to explain the game to readers who have never played it, including how a player becomes "it".

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: In shadow tag, the player who is "it" tries to step on another player's shadow, and that player then becomes "it".
Shadow tag is a game for sunny days, and it is best played in the late afternoon, when the players' shadows are long.
In shadow tag, the player who is "it" tries to step on the other players' shadows.
Shadow tag is a game that children like to play outdoors on sunny days.

why.en: The goal needs how the game works and how a player becomes "it". Only the choice ending "that player then becomes "it"" gives both; another stops halfway.
why.uz: Maqsad oʻyin qanday oʻynalishini va oʻyinchi qanday «it» boʻlishini talab qiladi. Ikkalasini faqat soyasi bosilgan oʻyinchi «it» boʻlishini aytgan javob beradi; boshqasi yarim yoʻlda toʻxtaydi.
why.ru: Нужно сказать, как идёт игра и как игрок становится «it». И то и другое даёт только вариант, где тот, на чью тень наступили, становится «it»; другой останавливается на полпути.
